name: card-bill-pay
title: Card Bill Pay
description: Before Pay, explains what the amount does: anything short of the total loses the interest-free period on the whole bill and on new spends, the minimum is turned into years and interest, and below the minimum or past the 3-day grace it shows the late fee and credit-bureau report.

meta.stops: Minimum due paid, interest charged anyway
meta.summary: Reads back what a credit card payment amount really costs before Pay, so paying the minimum or a little short doesn't quietly trigger interest.
meta.server: Take the amount due, minimum and due date from the issuer's records, and make the payment idempotent.
catches: Paying less than the total due, which loses the interest-free period
Paying only the minimum, shown as time and interest to clear the balance
Paying below the minimum or more than three days late (late fee and bureau reporting)
One-tap switch to paying the total
limits: Uses the statement figures and fee schedule you pass; issuers' terms differ
Interest projections are estimates and assume no new spending
Rules follow RBI's credit card directions for India only
a11y: Amount choices are labelled options; the custom amount has a <label>
The amount field is described by the warning lines
Pay uses aria-disabled while pending or at zero; focus moves to the first fix
Status is announced in a role="status" region

sources.label: RBI Master Direction: Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 (updated 7 Mar 2024)

rules.note: Informational; check the official source and your card's terms. Checked: interest-free period needs the entire outstanding paid by the due date and is suspended while the previous bill is outstanding; late charges and bureau reporting only after more than three days past due.
